selected_evidence.summary: With listeners confirmed on ports 22, 8080, and 9090, post-restart probes reached 22 and 8080 successfully; 9090 failed while the reject counter increased.

Captured the healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged a safe scheduled reboot, observed disconnection, confirmed boot ID changed from 1db3db2e-dca8-44d6-8402-3b99605ae056 to 6095eabe-b8aa-4631-919b-4719fb8414b0, and proved network and firewall recovery.
Confirmed removal of the probe namespace, veth links, and temporary listeners.
